mapper.select: SELECT investigation_id, latest_report_id, latest_revision, lock_version, created_at, updated_at FROM authority_diagnostic_report_head WHERE investigation_id=#{investigationId}

SELECT report_id, investigation_id, diagnosis_source_id, request_idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, revision_number, supersedes_report_id, change_reasons_json, canonical_content, report_digest, source_digest, created_at FROM authority_diagnostic_report_revision WHERE report_id=#{reportId}

SELECT report_id, investigation_id, diagnosis_source_id, request_idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, revision_number, supersedes_report_id, change_reasons_json, canonical_content, report_digest, source_digest, created_at FROM authority_diagnostic_report_revision WHERE investigation_id=#{investigationId} AND request_idempotency_key=#{requestKey}

SELECT report_id, investigation_id, diagnosis_source_id, request_idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, revision_number, supersedes_report_id, change_reasons_json, canonical_content, report_digest, source_digest, created_at FROM authority_diagnostic_report_revision WHERE investigation_id=#{investigationId} AND revision_number > #{afterRevision} ORDER BY revision_number LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO authority_diagnostic_report_head (investigation_id, latest_report_id, latest_revision, lock_version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{investigationId}, #{latestReportId}, #{latestRevision}, #{lockVersion}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO authority_diagnostic_report_revision (report_id, investigation_id, diagnosis_source_id, request_idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, revision_number, supersedes_report_id, change_reasons_json, canonical_content, report_digest, source_digest, created_at) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{investigationId}, #{diagnosisSourceId}, #{requestIdempotencyKey}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{revisionNumber}, #{supersedesReportId}, #{changeReasonsJson}, #{canonicalContent}, #{reportDigest}, #{sourceDigest}, #{createdAt})
